servers.name: Vend API Merchant
servers.description: Pay-per-call web intelligence: extract clean text from URLs, web search, link checking, domain WHOIS/DNS/SSL info, IP geolocation, and PDF text extraction. 22+ endpoints, no signup or API key, each call settles in Nano (XNO) via x402 at 0.0001–0.0005 XNO. Endpoint: `https://extract.paypercall.dev/mcp` · [Docs](https://extract.paypercall.dev) · Registry: `dev.paypercall.extract/vend-api-merchant`

servers.name: vibe-testing
servers.description: Code-aware Playwright browser testing for coding agents with regression diffs and HTML reports. Install: `npx -y vibe-testing@latest --mcp`

servers.name: VideoGen MCP
servers.description: Create editable videos from storyboards, scripts or voiceovers, generate media, edit projects and export results through the VideoGen API; account and generation credits required. Hosted HTTP with OAuth/API key or local stdio via `npx -y @videogen/mcp@2.2.1` with `VIDEOGEN_API_KEY`; MIT server; [Setup](https://videogen.io/videogen-mcp).

servers.name: VoiceMoat
servers.description: Personal brand tools for Twitter/X and LinkedIn: score a draft against your own voice profile, improve it, read your analytics and top posts, and publish or schedule after a preview and a confirmed second call; OAuth, needs a VoiceMoat Pro or Enterprise plan. Endpoint: `https://app.voicemoat.com/api/mcp` · [Website](https://voicemoat.com/mcp) · Registry: `com.voicemoat/voicemoat`

servers.name: VoxOdds
servers.description: Prediction-market research across Polymarket and Kalshi: odds for the same contract on both venues, the all-in executable price for a budget with estimated taker fees and which venue fills cheaper, trending markets, edge signals and an audited forecast track record. Read-only, no API key. Endpoint: `https://voxodds.com/mcp` · [Docs](https://voxodds.com/llms.txt) · Registry: `com.voxodds/voxodds`

servers.name: Warmerly
servers.description: Email warmup and cold outreach: mailbox health and warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks, placement tests, lead search, email verification, draft campaigns and inbox reply triage; campaigns are launched by the person in the dashboard, never by the assistant. OAuth sign-in, free plan. Endpoint: `https://app.warmerly.com/api/mcp` · [Docs](https://docs.warmerly.com/ai)

servers.name: Wheremind
servers.description: Hosted maps server: live place search, place details, nearby search, forward and reverse geocoding, and turn-by-turn directions, with no Maps API key to manage. Read-only tools; invite-only beta with OAuth or a stored Bearer header. Endpoint: `https://wheremind.ai/mcp` · [Docs](https://wheremind.ai/llms.txt) · Registry: `ai.wheremind/wheremind`

servers.name: Whisper Memos
servers.description: Official server for the Whisper Memos iPhone and Apple Watch voice memo app: list and read memo transcripts and summaries, list labels, view account details, and delete memos; it cannot create or edit memos. OAuth 2.1, approved in the iOS app. Endpoint: `https://whispermemos.com/mcp` · [Config](https://github.com/whispermemos/whisper-memos-plugin) · Registry: `com.whispermemos/whisper-memos`

servers.name: Wondel.ai Skills MCP
servers.description: Read-only access to 50 book-based agent skills and 12 guided journeys: recommends a framework for a task and serves its SKILL.md in-session. No account or auth. Endpoint: `https://skills.wondel.ai/mcp` · Registry: `io.github.mjaskolski/wondel-skills-mcp`

servers.name: Xquik
servers.description: X/Twitter search, extraction workflows, account insights, webhooks, and SDK access. [Docs](https://docs.xquik.com/mcp/overview)

servers.name: YouTube Transcripts MCP
servers.description: YouTube transcripts with video metadata (text, timestamped segments or SRT), filtered YouTube search, chapters, and timestamped extractive summaries; no YouTube API key. Local stdio free; hosted pay-per-call on Apify (API token). Endpoint: `https://parallelstudio--youtube-transcripts-mcp.apify.actor/mcp` · Registry: `io.github.gunnargray-dev/youtube-transcripts-mcp`

servers.name: Zambo
servers.description: 120 native tools across 17 products: strategy, code audit, lead generation, onchain scoring, credit discovery, prompt defense. Endpoint: `https://zambo.dev/api/mcp`, zero auth, no signup. [Website](https://zambo.dev)

servers.name: ZopDev MCP
servers.description: Cloud cost and infrastructure governance across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake: 263 tools (155 read, 108 write) spanning cost, resources, schedules, recommendations, budgets, and diagnostics. Read-only by default, with optional scoped writes. Install: `claude mcp add zopdev https://api.zop.dev/mcp-server -t http` (OAuth 2.1 signs you in; add `--header "Authorization: Bearer zn_pat_YOUR_TOKEN"` for CI) · [Repo](https://github.com/zopdev/mcp) · [Claude setup](https://zop.dev/learn/how-to/set-up-zopnight-mcp-for-claude)
